name: Aegis Steelcap
description: Level the pike at a square's corner so two faces overlap their points across the angle.

name: Bristle Pounce
description: Step round the file's pivot man, keeping the pike levelled as the front swings about.

name: Pikecollar Assault
description: Jab short from the face of the square at a foe testing the line for weakness.

name: Torrent Pikebands
description: Raise the shaft from the inner rank to cover the heads of the front men against falling blows.

name: Rupturing Pikeshoe
description: Sweep the levelled pike across the arc of the turn while qi widens the cut to every foe at the front.

name: Paralyzing Longpole
description: Weave the pike over and under a foe's weapon as the file turns, binding it with qi until the turn ends.

name: Glint Levelhold
description: Drive a heavy qi thrust at the moment the square closes on a foe, piercing armour at the corner.

name: Staunch Iron Pikeshaft
description: Spread qi along the crossed pikes of all four faces so the square holds as one bristling guard.

name: Daybreak Footspike
description: Pack field qi into the grip and shaft so the pike gains weight for the coming thrust.

name: Granite Press
description: Jab with the loaded pike so its added weight carries the point deep into the target.

name: Shafthauberk
description: Plant the butt and bear down on the shaft, using its added weight to hold the brace.

name: Racing Mastlength
description: Advance in short heavy steps with qi sunk into the soles so the pike never wavers.

name: Quelling Ashstaff
description: Strike the enemy weapon with the loaded shaft so the ringing shock numbs the foe's hands.

name: Pressbarrage
description: Thrust with a wave of qi trailing the point, so the shock reaches past the first layer of armour.

name: Veritypike
description: Let the brace take a blow, then send the absorbed force back up the shaft into the attacker.

name: Intentmast
description: Lean the loaded pike's weight across a foe's shield or weapon, pinning it down with steady qi pressure.

name: Mastbarrage
description: Load the pike through a long breath with field qi, then drive one thrust that punches through shield and plate.

name: Iron Pikehead
description: Hold the loaded brace so a charge breaks on the point, then step into the space the broken charge leaves.

name: Facet Footspike
description: Aim at the seam where the horse's armour plates meet at the breast and thrust along it.

name: Blaze Present
description: Jab at the gap between an armoured rider's helm and collar as he leans over his horse's neck.

name: Chimemast
description: Sidestep and rap a couched lance aside by its head just before it reaches your chest.

name: Couchout Pounce
description: Slide round to the flank of the armoured horse, where its armour is thinnest.

name: Wrecking Longpole
description: Compress qi into the point so it pierces the horse's chest armour at the plate seam.

name: Chime Pikehead
description: Twist the point into a hinge of the horse's armour and prise it open with qi.

name: Gyveshaft
description: Bind the enemy lance beneath your shaft and pin it to the ground with qi as the rider passes.

name: Pikecollar Cuirass
description: Set the butt and lock the pike with qi to bear an armoured charge without yielding a pace.

name: Rumblemast
description: After the horse falls, drive a qi-hardened thrust through the grounded rider's armour before he can rise.

name: Severing Brace
description: Rotate the shaft through the hands as it extends, so the thrust begins turning before it lands.

name: Unshaken Mastlength
description: Spin the pike from palm to palm before the body, whirring aside thrown points and darts.

name: Gustpike
description: Draw the pike back through a half turn, the spin turning aside the counter-thrust.

name: Siltmast
description: Lunge half a pace beyond comfortable reach with the rear foot dragging to extend the point's range.

name: Intent Pikebands
description: Change the hands' places around the turning shaft without losing the line of the point.

name: Hoarfrost Steelcap
description: Wheel the point in a small circle at arm's length to catch weapons aimed at head and chest.

name: Splintering Press
description: Send qi spiralling along the turning shaft so the point drills into armour as it lands.

name: Rumble Pikeshaft
description: Lash a thread of field qi beyond the point, striking a foe a hand past the pike's length.

name: Thorn Pikeshoe
description: Wrap a foe's weapon with the spinning shaft and draw it toward you under steady qi pressure.

name: Severing Levelhold
description: Whirl the long pike in a great circle charged with field qi, striking every foe within its reach.

name: Bracethrash
description: Lock the rotation at full reach and loose a field-qi thrust that crosses the gap in a single stroke.

name: Scything Brace
description: Two pikemen of paired files jab together at one foe, one aiming high and one low.

name: Aegismast
description: Meet shafts with the paired file's pikeman above the foe's weapon, forming a cross that stops the blow.

name: Sanguine Present
description: Thrust as your paired partner withdraws, so a point always threatens the foe.

name: Soaring Pikeshaft
description: Match steps with the paired file so both pikes advance as a single even line.

name: Pikecollar Plating
description: Cross your shaft over the partner's to turn a blow that threatens either of you.

name: Intent Bristle
description: Close both points on a foe's chest from either side, pinning him where he stands.

name: Scything Couchout
description: The second pike follows the first thrust into the same wound, qi making the echo strike harder.

name: Equipoise Footspike
description: Pass a pulse of qi to the paired pikeman as thrusts alternate, keeping both shafts equally strong.

name: Pikeshoe Greave
description: Pinch an enemy weapon between the shafts of two paired pikes and hold it there with qi.

name: Gustmast
description: Withdraw in mirrored steps with the paired file, keeping both points levelled as ground is given.

name: Glint Present
description: Cross two pikes' shock thrusts at one point, the qi from both shafts meeting in the foe's armour.

name: Funneling Press
description: Alternate thrust and guard with the partner in a four-stroke weave that answers any single attacker.

name: Couchout Leap
description: Rise on the toes as a hawk gathers itself, bringing the point up for a falling stroke.

name: Sanguine Pikehead
description: Crouch with the pike levelled low across the ground and jab upward from the stoop.

name: Pikegreave
description: Spread the arms wide on the shaft like a hawk's wings to catch cuts left and right.

name: Gust Brace
description: Let the point fall on a diagonal onto a raised guard, glancing off into the unguarded side.

name: Nova Mastlength
description: Plunge the pike downward in a hawk's dive with qi packed into the point, piercing a raised shield.

name: Gyve Steelcap
description: Swing the shaft in a swooping arc over the foe's weapon and press it down with qi.

name: Waning Pikebands
description: Open field qi above the head like a hawk's eye to sense the positions of foes across the basin.

name: Shaftthrash
description: Leap and fall point-first onto a foe with field qi loaded, driving a thrust through plate.

name: Granite Ashstaff
description: Leap back in a high arc after the stoop and land in a levelled stance with the point already aimed.

name: Vital Ashstaff
description: Hold the pike so point and ferrule share the weight evenly, ready to strike with either end.

name: Granite Brace
description: Jab the iron butt backward past the hip like a river bank turning aside the current.

name: Gust Couchout
description: Spin the pike end over end through the hands so the ferrule strikes where the point was.

name: Pikepounce
description: Step in the curve of a river's bend, keeping the pike levelled throughout.

name: Steelcap Fastness
description: Guard with the shaft held across both ends so a blow meets wood on either side.

name: Splintering Longpole
description: Strike with the point then the ferrule in one turn, each end carrying its own thread of qi.

name: Aegispike
description: Plant the ferrule and let qi flow down the shaft like a river held between banks.

name: Shaftplating
description: Pin the enemy weapon to the ground with the ferrule while the point keeps the foe at bay.

name: Lot Pikecollar
description: Cycle point thrust, ferrule strike and shaft sweep in a flowing round, each stroke covering the last.

name: Furrowing Bristle
description: Surge qi to both ends in turn, ending with a ferrule thrust that drives the foe back onto the point.

name: Waningshaft
description: Sight along the shaft and take a bearing on the foe, fixing the point's line before he moves.

name: Iron Longpole
description: Level the pike into the wind so its pressure steadies the shaft against a foe's push.

name: Soaring Mastlength
description: Step forward along the taken bearing without letting the point stray from its line.

name: Bristle Maelstrom
description: Jab fast along the bearing line, the wind at the back adding speed to the thrust.

name: Murkshaft
description: Turn the shaft across a blow as a pole turns a crosswind, letting the strike slide away.

name: Ponderous Pikehead
description: Hold the point at a foe's chest on the plateau edge, leaving him nowhere to retreat.

name: Lambasting Present
description: Let qi ride the wind along the shaft and drive the point down the bearing into armour.

name: Hoarfrost Footspike
description: Lay the shaft over a foe's weapon and bind it with qi as a wind pins grass to the ground.

name: Masthauberk
description: Meet a rushing foe's shoulder with the shaft and turn him aside like a gust turning a leaf.

name: Ravaging Pikebands
description: Drive field qi and the full wind behind a single thrust that carries through shield and mail.

name: Granite Pikeshoe
description: Swear to hold the bearing and lock the braced pike with qi, giving no ground to the push.

name: Rumble Brace
description: Jab from an open stance with no wall behind, committing to the thrust as sworn.

name: Aegis Ashstaff
description: Stand with the pike levelled on open ground and the back to the wind, refusing to give way.

name: Silt Press
description: Step forward on the oath, never back, the pike's point staying levelled on the foe.

name: Mayhem Ashstaff
description: Rap the edge of the foe's weapon with a quick shaft stroke to unbalance it.

name: Facet Bristle
description: Thrust with qi and the wind behind it, the sworn word steadying the pike through contact.

name: Facet Pikecollar
description: Hold the braced bearing with qi so the shaft does not bend before a heavy push.

name: Charter Pikeshaft
description: Speak the oath at the instant of impact and lock the pike with qi so a charge breaks unmoved.

name: Iron Levelhold
description: Surge forward on the oath with full qi behind the point, spitting a foe who stands in the open.

name: Gustshaft
description: Move along a straight line at speed with the feet together and the pike levelled.

name: Unbroken Longpole
description: Press the levelled pike forward against a shove while keeping the bearing exactly where it was taken.

name: Mightbrace
description: Set the point on the line of a rushing foe so his own speed spits him on it.

name: Crippling Pikeshoe
description: Beat an enemy shaft aside with a cutting stroke like a gust catching a banner's edge.

name: Gust Pikehead
description: Slide backward while the point holds its bearing on the foe, giving ground without losing the line.

name: Unflinching Mastlength
description: Lift the shaft overhead in a cutting arc to turn a heavy downward blow aside.

name: Mastthrash
description: Wedge a qi-driven point into the front of a charge so the rush splits around it.

name: Waning Steelcap
description: Read the oncoming charge in the wind's pressure on the shaft and judge its speed and weight.

name: Hoarfrost Levelhold
description: Pin a foe's weapon to the bearing line with the shaft and qi so he cannot swing it clear.

name: Mastplating
description: Receive the charge on the shaft and send its force back along the same line with qi.

name: Harpooning Rumble Pikebands
description: Meet a charge with a thrust driven by field qi and the wind at the point's back.

name: Grinding Levelhold
description: Press into the gap a broken charge leaves, sweeping the pike across the stunned front.
